svg.title: A finite boundary changes the apparent memory law
svg.desc: Exact magnitudes of three normalized linear diffusion impedances. The curves expose finite transmissive and blocking low-frequency limits; they are not fits to a cell, software system, or universal memory kernel.
svg.text: A finite boundary changes the apparent memory law
Z_open=tanh(sqrt(i q))/sqrt(i q); Z_block=coth(sqrt(i q))/sqrt(i q); q=omega tau_D
normalized angular frequency q = omega tau_D · logarithmic
a q^(-1/2) band does not prove
